title: SG-6.4 · Wire Approve, Retry and Reject in AdminApp
summary: AdminApp executes approve, retry and reject on the current execution, reloads, shows errors and returns to the token gate on 401
description: Context: ExecutionPanel already renders Approve and Retry buttons via onApprove/onRetry props, and client.ts already has approveExecution and retryExecution, but AdminApp passes no handlers and there is no reject call or Reject control. Desired behavior: each action calls the backend, reloads Round and execution data, shows failures, and a 401 returns to the token gate. Expected result: the admin can approve, retry or reject from the console. Why: supervised publishing requires the admin to act on executions.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve is sent with the Bearer token and the data reloads
Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then POST .../retry is sent and the data reloads
Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then POST .../reject is sent and the data reloads
Given an action that responds 401, when it is clicked, then the token gate with 'Invalid token' is shown
Given an action that responds 500, when it is clicked, then an alert with the error message is shown

preserve: Existing AdminApp token gate, stepper and panel behavior

technical_constraints: React + TypeScript, Vitest with mocked fetch only
Use adminRequest and ApiError from game/frontend/src/api/client.ts
definition_of_done: All three requirements implemented and unit tests pass
